stories.title: Bitcoin reclaims $80,000, Ethereum nears $2,620 despite hawkish Fed, CLARITY Act setback

en.title: Bitcoin reclaims $80,000, Ethereum nears $2,620 despite hawkish Fed, CLARITY Act setback
en.summary: Bitcoin recovered to $80,000 and Ethereum approached $2,620 as cryptocurrency markets rebounded despite Federal Reserve hawkishness and regulatory uncertainty. The recovery was supported by improving market sentiment, lower oil prices and short-squeeze liquidations, though elevated interest rates and regulatory concerns continue to influence market direction.

en.title: Warren Buffett sounds alarm as stock market warning returns for only second time in 155 years
en.summary: Warren Buffett has expressed caution about stock valuations as the S&P 500's CAPE ratio reaches historically elevated levels seen only rarely in 155 years. Elevated valuation metrics may suggest weaker future returns, though they do not necessarily predict immediate market declines.

en.summary: Mutual funds sold significant positions in five smallcap stocks during August, with Gland Pharma, LIC Housing Finance, Gujarat Energy, CAMS and Amber Enterprises India experiencing the heaviest fund outflows among smaller-cap securities.

stories.title: Only 2 of 23 mutual fund themes gained in August; IPO, defence stay green as auto, railways and tech slide : Report

en.title: Only 2 of 23 mutual fund themes gained in August; IPO, defence stay green as auto, railways and tech slide : Report
en.summary: Only IPO and defence themes posted gains among 23 mutual fund categories in August as Indian equities faced widespread selling pressure. Auto, railways and technology stocks declined sharply while overall equity fund inflows contracted significantly, though commodities remained the best performer year-to-date.
